bull_thesis.summary: Ethereum's growing decentralized finance ecosystem and increasing adoption of non-fungible tokens positions it for long-term growth. Improving scalability through layer 2 solutions and the transition to proof-of-stake will enhance user experience.
catalysts: Regulatory clarity on DeFi and NFTs
bull_thesis.price_target_rationale: Based on increasing adoption and improving technology

bear_thesis.summary: Regulatory uncertainty and potential competition from other blockchain platforms pose significant risks to Ethereum's market share. High energy consumption and environmental concerns associated with proof-of-work consensus mechanisms also threaten its long-term viability.
risks: Regulatory crackdown on DeFi and NFTs
Loss of market share to competing blockchains
bear_thesis.downside_scenario: Massive regulatory crackdown leading to significant decline in ETH price

portfolio_manager_output.stop_loss_rationale: 20% decline from entry point to limit potential losses
